# Spring Dental

> Family & cosmetic dental practice in Dayton, Ohio, led by Dr. Ravinder Gampa, DDS. Serving West Carrollton, Kettering, Centerville, Springfield, Miamisburg and Oakwood for 15+ years. Rated 4.4/5 across 111+ Google reviews.

## About
- Dr. Ravinder Gampa earned his BDS (1982) and MDS in Oral Medicine & Radiology (1987) from Osmania University, Hyderabad, India, and has practiced in the Dayton area since 2000. Member of the American Dental Association, Ohio Dental Association and Dayton Dental Society.
- Formerly known as West Carrollton Family Dental.
